title: A Gift for My Beloved

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW A Gift for My Beloved.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Manny (Breath of the Wild)|Manny]] |location= Hateno Village |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Silver Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|A Gift for My Beloved||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|A Gift for My Beloved}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Hateno Village}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== This [[Side Quest]] begins after [[Link]] speaks to [[Manny (Breath of the Wild)|Manny]], who is loitering outside of [[The Great Ton Pu Inn]]. Manny claims that he is watching for anyone suspicious coming into town, but slips up and says "beauties" instead.{{Cite|So I gotta check and make sure if any beauties—er, I mean—suspicious folks have come around here.|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} If Link says that his job sounds difficult, Manny will agree with him.{{Cite|[Sounds tough.] Yeah. It's a tough job! I'm over here makin' it look easy.|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} If Link asks about his mistake, Manny will sigh.{{Cite|[Beauties?] {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|*sigh*}}}}|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} No matter how Link responds, Manny claims that his actions can be explained by looking at [[Prima]], the proprietor of The Great Ton Pu Inn.{{Cite|If you're lucky enough to stay at the {{Color BotW|Blue|Ton Pu Inn}}, you'll see what I mean. Say hullo to Prima for me if you do. {{Small|Not that she even knows who I am...}}|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} He is debating on finding a gift for her, but since he does not know what to get her, he asks Link what he thinks she would like.{{Cite|{{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|This is tough… I have to give her SOMETHING…}}}} What kind of gift do you think Prima at the {{Color BotW|Blue|Ton Pu Inn}} would want? Just take a guess.|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} Still, he is embarrassed about his current lack of success with Prima and insists that he is not the interested party.{{Cite|It's not for me, you understand. It's for...my buddy's friend.|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} After this conversation, the Side Quest will begin. Prima is inside The Great Ton Pu Inn manning the front desk. Link has the opportunity to ask her about what she likes by speaking directly to her, as opposed to over the counter. However, Prima has no interest in being truthful with him and simply says the first thing that comes to mind, which happens to be [[Restless Cricket]]s.{{Cite| [What do you like?] {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|Why is he asking? Whatever, I'll just say something random...}}}} I'll tell you something I really like... {{Color BotW|Red|Crickets}}.|Prima|BotW}} She "confesses" that she would like nothing more than to own 100 of them.{{Cite|It's my dream to have my very own collection of {{Color BotW|Red|100 restless crickets}}. {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|As if...}}}}|Prima|BotW}} Link must then return to Manny and give him the information.{{Cite|[I talked to Prima.] What? Prima told you what she wants?! {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|Prima...never even talks to me...}}}} *ahem* I mean, that's cool, that's cool… SO THEN, WHAT IS IT?!|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} While he is pleased that he and Prima appear to have a common interest, he is doubtful that he can find so many Restless Crickets on his own.{{Cite|Prima wants {{Color BotW|Red|restless crickets}}? And {{Color BotW|Red|100 of them}}?! Hahaha! What a small world! I love {{Color BotW|Red|restless crickets}}! I'm a connoisseur of them! {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|I think that's what that word means...}}}} But catching {{Color BotW|Red|100}} of them is gonna be tough. Think you could help me get started on those?|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} As a result, he asks Link to gather 10 for him.{{Cite|How about you get me... {{Color BotW|Red|10}} of them? I'll get you something nice for your trouble.|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} Once all 10 have been gathered, Link can return to Manny with them.{{Cite|[I got the goods!] You have some {{Color BotW|Red|restless crickets}} already?! Wow, that was fast! {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|I haven't even caught one yet...}}}} Well, lemme see those {{Color BotW|Red|restless crickets}} you caught!|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} Link will be rewarded with a Silver Rupee for his trouble.{{Cite|You really got them? I thought you were just messing with me. OK, so... Hrm... Yup, that's {{Color BotW|Red|10}}. Thanks, I'll take 'em. A little somethin' for your troubles...|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} Manny admits that, once he gathers all 100 Restless Crickets, he intends to use them to ask Prima on a date.{{Cite|Right then! I'll go ahead and catch the rest of 'em. Then I'll take 'em to Prima and we'll have that d-d-date... {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|Oh, no! My s-s-s-stutter...}}}}|Manny (Breath of the Wild)|BotW}} When he finishes speaking, the Side Quest will be completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | A friend of Manny's wants more than anything to catch the eye of Prima, owner of the Ton Pu Inn.

All you have to do is {{Color BotW|Red|ask}} Prima what she loves most. |- | 2 | Prima said her dream is to have a collection of 100 {{Color BotW|Red|restless crickets}}.

You should break the news to {{Color BotW|Red|Manny}}. |- | 3 | Upon learning that Prima's dream is to have a collection of 100 restless crickets, Manny enlisted your help as a bug catcher.

Start by collecting {{Color BotW|Red|10 restless crickets}} and bringing them to Manny. |- | Complete | You delivered the 10 restless crickets to Manny and received a reward.

He confessed that he was the one who wanted to catch Prima's eye. His plan now is to find the other 90 restless crickets on his own and present them to Prima when he asks her out on a date.

It seems you're off the hook... }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hateno Village * Manny (Breath of the Wild) * Manny's Beloved }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
